items.title: The Road to Evercold Promotion Has Begun!
items.summary: The Road to Evercold has begun, helping you prepare for the upcoming release of Evercold! Our longest Free Login Campaign ever! Play free up to 30 days! Tales of Adventure: Winter's Prelude available for a limited time! A new Letter from th
items.content:
The Road to Evercold has begun, helping you prepare for the upcoming release of Evercold!
  • Our longest Free Login Campaign ever! Play free up to 30 days!
  • Tales of Adventure: Winter's Prelude available for a limited time!
A new Letter from the Producer from Producer and Director Naoki Yoshida has been published to mark the start of the promotion—be sure to check it out!

Free Login Campaign Schedule

From Monday, November 16, 2026 at 12:00 a.m. (PST) / 8:00 (GMT) / 19:00 (AEDT) to Thursday, January 14, 2027 at 6:59 a.m. (PST) / 14:59 (GMT) / Friday, 15 January 2027 at 1:59 (AEDT) As a token of our appreciation to players who have continued to support FFXIV and are not eligible for the Free Login Campaign, we will send a selection of items via the moogle delivery service. To receive the items, eligible players must log in before maintenance for the release of Patch 8.0 begins.

Tales of Adventure: Winter’s Prelude Availability Period

From Monday, November 16, 2026 at 12:00 a.m. (PST) / 8:00 (GMT) / 19:00 (AEDT) to the release of Patch 8.0 For Warriors of Light returning for adventure after completing the Hydaelyn and Zodiark saga, now is the perfect time to catch up ahead of Evercold! For a limited time, players who have completed the main scenario quest "Endwalker" can purchase Tales of Adventure: Winter's Prelude at a special price, allowing them to jump straight to Patch 7.5. Catch up on the latest story and prepare for the adventures to come in Evercold! Visit the Road to Evercold special site for details.

items.content:
The FINAL FANTASY XVI crossover event, The Path Infernal, returns to Eorzea! Participate in the event to obtain several event items, including the Torgal mount, the Metian Attire inspired by protagonist Clive Rosfield, a minion, orchestrion rolls, and more. Whether you missed the previous event or simply wish to experience the adventure again, don't miss out!

Event Duration

From Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 12:00 a.m. (PST) / 8:00 (GMT) / 19:00 (AEDT) to Wednesday, December 9, 2026 at 6:59 a.m. (PST) / 14:59 (GMT) / Thursday, 10 December at 1:59 (AEDT)

How to Participate

Begin the quest "A Land on Fire" by speaking to the Neophyte Adventurer in Ul’dah, Steps of Nald (X:8.8 Y:9.8). * Players must be level 50 and above to start the quest. * Players must have completed the main scenario quest “The Ultimate Weapon.” * This event is identical to previous iterations. * Event quest can be replayed by utilizing the Seasonal Event Replay feature.

Rewards

Visit the special site for more details.

items.summary: Keybound Brawler, a new event that tests your typing prowess, is coming to the Manderville Gold Saucer! The first iteration of the event will be a special collaboration with the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE series. Participate in the collaborat
items.content:
Keybound Brawler, a new event that tests your typing prowess, is coming to the Manderville Gold Saucer! The first iteration of the event will be a special collaboration with the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE series. Participate in the collaboration stages to obtain MGC which can be exchanged for numerous rewards, including collaboration attire, a mount, emote, and more!

Event Duration

From Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 19:00 (AEDT) to the release of Patch 8.0 * The end date listed on Steam does not reflect the release date for Patch 8.0.

How to Participate

Begin the quest "Keyward Bound" by speaking to the Catlike Mammet in The Gold Saucer (X:5.4 Y:7.0). * Players must be level 15 and above to start the quest. * Players must first complete one of the following main scenario quests: "The Gridanian Envoy," "The Ul'dahn Envoy," or "The Lominsan Envoy." * Players must first complete the quest "It Could Happen to You" to be able to travel to the Manderville Gold Saucer via airship from any of the three city-states. * Please note that a keyboard is required to participate in this content. Gamepads and on-screen keyboards cannot be used.

Rewards

* After this collaboration event has ended, it will be held as a special event at irregular intervals. Visit the special site for more details.
